verdict.rationale: Evidence shows n8n exposes a REST API (n8n-docs-16) and a CLI (n8n-docs-17), plus custom-code nodes for JS/Python (n8n-gh-1), but there is no mention of an official SDK (e.g., a published Python/JS client library) for building against n8n programmatically, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s across all candidate paths, suggesting no formal API-driven SDK generation.
